# Card reference

<!-- Generated by tools/audit/card_table.cpp. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every card the engine registers: 132 cards and 41 Evolutions. The numbers are read from the engine
itself, by spawning each card on an empty board, so they are the values a
match is played with.

Regenerate it after changing a card, from the repository root:

```powershell
powershell -File tools/audit/build.ps1 card_table
tools/audit/bin/card_table.exe docs/CARDS.md
```

Without MSVC, under WSL: `bash tools/audit/build.sh card_table && tools/audit/bin/card_table docs/CARDS.md`.

## How to read it

- **HP and damage** are the real game's level-11 values, for the card's main
  unit. A shield is listed separately. An Inferno's damage climbs while it
  stays on one target, so it shows the first and the last step. Void's three
  numbers are its damage against one, a few and many targets.
- **Units** is how many bodies one card places. A second kind of body is
  listed after a plus sign (Goblin Giant carries Spear Goblins). When both
  kinds carry the card's name, the split is in brackets: Ram Rider's 2 (1 + 1)
  is the ram and its rider.
- **Hit speed** is seconds between attacks (the engine counts 10 ticks per
  second). For a spell that hits more than once, it is the time between hits,
  and the damage column shows damage per hit times the number of hits.
- **Range** is in tiles. For a spell it is the radius, or the width and
  rolling distance of The Log and Barbarian Barrel.
- **Speed** is tiles per second. The real game's speed tier is named only
  when the speed is exactly on it, so a speed with no tier is off-tier.
- **Spawner buildings** (huts, Tombstone, Goblin Drill) show no damage: they
  fight through the troops they spawn.
- **Targets** is what the card attacks. "Buildings" means it walks past
  troops to hit buildings.
- **Evolution rows show the evolved form.** An Evolution keeps the base card's
  name, so use the ID to tell them apart ("Evolution of 1" is Archers).

Found a number that does not match the real game? Please open a
[card accuracy report](https://github.com/itzik123/ClashRoyaleAi/issues/new?template=card_accuracy.yml)
with a source for the correct value.
